Grubhub (GRUB) Holder Selkirk Management Has Cut Holding as Share Value Rose; Cobblestone Capital Advisors Has Increased Its Apple (AAPL) Holding by $533,533 as Stock Price Declined
May 2, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Selkirk Management Llc decreased its stake in Grubhub Inc. (GRUB) by 16.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Selkirk Management Llc sold 26,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 44.05% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 131,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.41 million, down from 157,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Selkirk Management Llc who had been investing in Grubhub Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $8.09 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 8.39% or $8.49 during the last trading session, reaching $92.65. About 5.24M shares traded or 169.85% up from the average. GrubHub Inc. (NYSE:GRUB) has risen 206.92% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 195.37% the S&P500.
Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.84% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc bought 3,157 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 85,368 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.45M, up from 82,211 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $858.02 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.32% or $3.84 during the last trading session, reaching $169.1. About 41.44 million shares traded or 9.71% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
